summary: M. S. Nagaraja Rao worked in history, archaeology, and Indology. He studied at the University of Mysore (~1953–1955) and served as Director at the Department of Archaeology, Museums and Heritage (~1972–1983).

M. Seshagiri Sastri worked in Indology and linguistics. In 1899, he was attested as Curator at the Government Oriental Manuscripts Library and Professor of Sanskrit and Comparative Philology at Presidency University, Kolkata.
M. Shinoda is an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar. Shinoda attended Agoura High School (~1991–1995), studied at the Art Center College of Design (~1995–1998), and studied under Seiren Matsunami.

Mabel Haynes Bode was an Indologist and Buddhist studies scholar. She studied under Cecil Bendall, T. W. Rhys Davids, and Eduard Müller-Hess at the University of Bern (PhD ~1905–1908), later holding posts at UCL (~1912–1917) and SOAS (~1917–1922).
Madan Mohan Malaviya worked in Indology and other fields. He studied at the University of Calcutta (~1880–1884) and the University of Allahabad (~1889–1892), and founded Banaras Hindu University.

Madeleine Biardeau was a scholar of Indology, philosophy, and religious studies. She studied at the École normale supérieure de jeunes filles (~1943–1946) and served as an enseignant at the École Pratique des Hautes Études (~1956–1989).
Madhav Krishna Sharma was an Indologist who studied under C. Kunhan Raja. In 1952, he served as an Inspector for the Department of Sanskrit Education in Rajasthan.
Madhav M. Deshpande is a scholar of Indology and linguistics. He served as a Professor at the University of Michigan, with his position attested in 1976 and from 2006 to 2009.
Madhu Khanna is an Indology and religious studies scholar. In 2012, she held attested posts at Jamia Millia Islamia and the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts.

Madhukar Anant Mehendale worked in Indology and linguistics. He served as Joint Secretary of the Linguistic Society of India (attested 1955) and Professor of Sanskrit at Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute (attested 1970 and 1983).

Madhusudan Dhaky was a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology. After studying at Fergusson College (~1944–1949), he served as Associate Director at the American Institute of Indian Studies (~1966–1996; also attested 2012).

Mae Chee Huynh Kim Lan is a scholar of Buddhist studies. She earned an MA in Buddhist Studies at Mahachulalongkornrajavidyalaya University, studying under thesis advisers Phra Suthithammanuwat and Veerachart Nimanong (attested 2010).
Mahesh A. Deokar is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and linguistics. He held posts at Savitribai Phule Pune University as Professor (attested 2011) and Head (attested 2020–2021).

Maheshachandra Nyayaratna Bhattacharyya was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied under Edward Byles Cowell. He served as Principal of Sanskrit College and University, attested in 1882 and 1914.

Mahinda Deegalle is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies. Educated at Harvard Divinity School and the University of Chicago, he held posts at Harvard (~1999–2000), Bath Spa University (~2000–2021), and Colgate University (~2012–2013).

Maho Iuchi is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. She completed a PhD at Otani University (~2003–2008) and held an attested post as a guest researcher at Kobe City University of Foreign Studies in 2010.
Mai Mishiro is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. She held attested positions at the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science in 2011 and at Waseda University in 2016.

Makio Takemura is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy who studied at the University of Tokyo (~1967–1975). He held faculty posts at Tokyo, Mie, Tsukuba (~1980–2002), and Toyo University (~2002–2020).

Makio Ueno is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a PhD at Otani University by 2009. He subsequently held posts there as an assistant professor (attested 2010–2012) and faculty member (attested 2022).
Makoto Funaoka is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. After studying at Meiji University, he served as a professor at Hokkai-Gakuen University (~1985–2017).
